originality.rationale: The exact same-model 2026 paper already carries out the decisive calculation for the nonconstant boundary two-cycle: telescoping the Ricker equations gives mean one, AM-GM gives product below one, and the predator block of the monodromy matrix gives the geometric-mean invasion threshold. The submitted arbitrary-period statement repeats those identical three textbook steps with k factors instead of two. The published boundary recurrence itself immediately gives the period-k telescoping identity, and multiplying the scalar transverse derivative over k iterates is the definition of the Floquet multiplier. Under the audit rule that direct corollaries and mechanically implied extensions are covered even without matching wording, the final claim does not survive originality.
